ideas.title: One map for above and below
ideas.body: AirReveal opens on one map: the planes in the sky around you and the landmarks below, even with no signal. Tap a plane for its card and pull it up for its photo, route and aircraft; your flights glow gold on their airports with a countdown.

ideas.title: Every airport in the world
ideas.body: Every airport on the map: the big hubs from anywhere, every airfield as you zoom in. Quiet sky where you are? Tap a busy airport and Look Around Here to see its planes and places.

ideas.title: Planes drawn as what they are
ideas.body: Airliners, turboprops, business jets, light aircraft, fast jets and helicopters each have their own icon on the map.

ideas.title: Sit in its cockpit
ideas.body: Tap a plane above you, then Sit in Its Cockpit: its flight deck, its route ahead and its own instruments. Choose Cockpit, Cockpit and HUD, HUD Only or Instruments, and drag to look around.

ideas.title: Watch It Fly
ideas.body: The plane you tapped in 3D, in its shape and its airline's colours.

ideas.title: Landmark photos and stories
ideas.body: Landmarks come with photos and their story from Wikipedia, kept on your phone for the air.

ideas.title: Made for iPad and iPhone Duo
ideas.body: A fresh night-sky look, and on iPad and an open iPhone Duo your flight's details stay beside the map.

ideas.title: A new Help with pictures
ideas.body: The in-app Help is rewritten as a guide for new users, in the order of a trip, with a picture for every step in six languages.
